# site/ — the live static site as shipped

24 pages: 12 Dutch at the root, 12 English under `en/`. Plus `robots.txt` and
`sitemap.xml`.

**These are build output, not source.** They are generated by a Python pipeline
in the original repo (`tools/build.py`) and committed. The English pages are
generated from the Dutch ones via `reference/i18n-en.json` — editing them
directly is pointless, they are overwritten on the next build.

**Images, video and the brochure PDF are not included** (36 MB). They live in the
original repo at `site/assets/img`, `site/assets/video` and
`site/assets/impact-brochure.pdf`. The HTML references them by those paths, so
pages will render without images until they are copied across.

CSS, JS and brand assets *are* included, in `../assets/`.
